lines.zh: 四蹄落地，土不扬，只有闷响。
lines.en: Four hooves land without dust, only a dull thud.

lines.zh: 我没有蹄铁，蹄子是骨。
lines.en: I wear no shoes. My hooves are bone.

lines.zh: 骑士一夹腿，我就起步。
lines.en: One squeeze of the knight's legs and I start.

lines.zh: 我跑起来不喘，因为没有肺。
lines.en: I do not pant when I run. I have no lungs.

lines.zh: 草在蹄下断，却不沾泥。
lines.en: Grass breaks under my hooves and takes no mud.

lines.zh: 我走直线，绕路是骑士的事。
lines.en: I walk straight. Detours are the rider's business.

lines.zh: 背上的重量，我早就习惯。
lines.en: The weight on my back is long familiar.

lines.zh: 坡再陡，我也一步步踩实。
lines.en: However steep, I set each hoof firmly.

lines.zh: 夜里赶路，我不需要灯。
lines.en: We travel by night. I need no lamp.

lines.zh: 我的影子在墙上跑得比我快。
lines.en: My shadow outruns me along the wall.

lines.zh: 路面有坑，我用蹄子探出来。
lines.en: There are holes ahead; my hooves find them.

lines.zh: 我不打响鼻，气息早没了。
lines.en: I do not snort. My breath ran out long ago.

lines.zh: 我站着睡，四条腿撑着。
lines.en: I sleep standing, held up by four legs.

lines.zh: 骑士不动，我也不动。
lines.en: The knight is still, so I am still.

lines.zh: 没有草料，我也不需要。
lines.en: There is no fodder. I need none.

lines.zh: 脊骨突出来，正好架鞍。
lines.en: My spine juts out — a natural saddle frame.

lines.zh: 我记得草原，可那是很久前。
lines.en: I remember grassland, but that was long ago.

lines.zh: 蝇虫不来，它们知道我不新鲜。
lines.en: No flies come. They know I am not fresh.

lines.zh: 我把头低下，等骑士的手。
lines.en: I lower my head and wait for the rider's hand.

lines.zh: 月亮照着我，我照不出影。
lines.en: Moonlight falls on me; I cast no shadow.

lines.zh: 鞍上的骨头压着我脊背。
lines.en: The bones in the saddle press my back.

lines.zh: 我耳朵动一下，听见远处的蹄声。
lines.en: My ear twitches. Hoofbeats, far off.

lines.zh: 没有人来喂我，也没人来骑。
lines.en: Nobody comes to feed me, or to ride.

lines.zh: 我张嘴，只咬到空气。
lines.en: I open my mouth and bite only air.

lines.zh: 悚陵的石碑旁，我站了很多年。
lines.en: By the dread tomb's stone I have stood for years.

lines.zh: 尾巴只剩几根筋，风一吹就摆。
lines.en: My tail is a few sinews, swaying in the wind.

lines.zh: 骑士的骨手搭在我颈上，很沉。
lines.en: The knight's bony hand rests heavy on my neck.

lines.zh: 远处的雷龙叫了一声，我耳朵动了动。
lines.en: A dread dragon calls far off, and my ear twitches.

lines.zh: 你身上有活马的味道。
lines.en: You carry the scent of a living horse.

lines.zh: 你想摸我的颈？先问骑士。
lines.en: You want to touch my neck? Ask the rider first.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛在眶里干了。
lines.en: My eyes dried out in their sockets.

lines.zh: 你站在我侧后，那里会挨踢。
lines.en: You stand at my rear flank. That invites a kick.

lines.zh: 你也骑马吗？你的马比我软。
lines.en: Do you ride? Your horse looks softer than I.

lines.zh: 我不认陌生人，只认缰绳。
lines.en: I know no strangers, only reins.

lines.zh: 你手里有苹果？那没用。
lines.en: An apple in your hand? That will not work.

lines.zh: 我低头看你，比你高两头。
lines.en: I look down at you, two heads taller.

lines.zh: 你的手靠近，我就想起鞭子。
lines.en: When your hand comes near, I remember whips.

lines.zh: 你喘气的声音，我听得很清楚。
lines.en: I hear your breathing quite clearly.

lines.zh: 我不会让你骑，除非骑士同意。
lines.en: I will not carry you unless the knight agrees.

lines.zh: 我的牙齿比你的手掌硬。
lines.en: My teeth are harder than your palm.

lines.zh: 你往后退了，我看得见。
lines.en: You are stepping back. I can see that.

lines.zh: 看着我，别去看我的肋骨。
lines.en: Look at me, not at my ribs.

lines.zh: 你身上有草料的味道，我不吃。
lines.en: You smell of hay. I don't eat.

lines.zh: 你的马在我身后躲着，我看得见。
lines.en: Your horse hides behind you. I can see it.

lines.zh: 你在数我的肋骨，我数你的脚步。
lines.en: You count my ribs; I count your steps.

lines.zh: 我低下脖子，不是让你摸。
lines.en: I lower my neck, and it isn't for petting.

lines.zh: 我的皮裂了，里面没有血。
lines.en: My hide splits. Nothing bleeds inside.

lines.zh: 这一下踢在我旧伤上。
lines.en: That blow lands on an old wound.

lines.zh: 我退了，鞍上的骑士没退。
lines.en: I step back. The rider does not.

lines.zh: 骨头响，但没断。
lines.en: Bone creaks. It does not break.

lines.zh: 你砍断我一根肋骨。
lines.en: You cut through one of my ribs.

lines.zh: 我甩头，痛感才慢慢到。
lines.en: I toss my head; the ache arrives late.

lines.zh: 我的马鞍松了，得重新系。
lines.en: My saddle has slipped. It needs re-tying.

lines.zh: 骑士拍了拍我的颈。
lines.en: The knight pats my neck.

lines.zh: 我低吼，那声音不像马。
lines.en: I growl low. It does not sound like a horse.

lines.zh: 你再砍，我就踢你。
lines.en: Cut me again and I will kick you.

lines.zh: 草和苹果都放我嘴边了。
lines.en: Grass and apples, both held to my mouth.

lines.zh: 我早忘了怎么吃。
lines.en: I forgot how to eat long ago.

lines.zh: 骑士没点头，我不碰。
lines.en: The knight has not nodded. I will not touch it.

lines.zh: 你把粮袋举高，想让我跪下？
lines.en: Raising a feed bag, hoping I kneel?

lines.zh: 我的肚子是空的，空的不会响。
lines.en: My belly is empty. Empty bellies do not growl.

lines.zh: 别拿食物换我，去换骑士。
lines.en: Do not trade food for me. Trade the knight.

lines.zh: 那根胡萝卜，还挂着泥土。
lines.en: That carrot still has soil on it.

lines.zh: 我闻到了甜味，可我不动。
lines.en: I smell the sweetness. I do not move.

lines.zh: 有人这样喂过我，后来我死了。
lines.en: Someone fed me like that once. Then I died.

lines.zh: 收起来吧，我不吃第二顿。
lines.en: Put it away. I will not eat a second meal.

lines.zh: 别碰我的后腿，会踢。
lines.en: Do not touch my hind leg. It kicks.

lines.zh: 你撞上来，像撞到一根树干。
lines.en: You bump into me as if into a tree trunk.

lines.zh: 我让开半步，是给骑士面子。
lines.en: I shift half a step out of respect for the rider.

lines.zh: 人群挤时，我咬人不咬草。
lines.en: In a crowd, I bite people, not grass.

lines.zh: 你的肩擦过我的鞍，很凉。
lines.en: Your shoulder brushed my saddle. Very cold.

lines.zh: 我的蹄子不会让路。
lines.en: My hooves do not yield the road.

lines.zh: 你把我的缰碰歪了。
lines.en: You knocked my rein crooked.

lines.zh: 我甩头，绳子抽到你脸上。
lines.en: I toss my head; the rein snaps across your face.

lines.zh: 退开，鞍上还有东西要下来。
lines.en: Stand clear. Something is dismounting from my back.

lines.zh: 撞一下不要紧，我的皮是硬的。
lines.en: One collision is fine. My hide has hardened.

lines.zh: 我没有配偶，只有骑士。
lines.en: I have no mate. Only a rider.

lines.zh: 活马才会配种，我是坐骑。
lines.en: Living horses breed. I am a mount.

lines.zh: 尸巫造我时，只想到战场。
lines.en: The lich made me thinking only of battlefields.

lines.zh: 我的同类还在马厩里烂着。
lines.en: My kin are rotting in a stable still.

lines.zh: 另一匹尸马？我们只会并排站。
lines.en: Another dead horse? We only stand abreast.

lines.zh: 马驹？我这副身子生不出来。
lines.en: A foal? This body cannot produce one.

lines.zh: 我不记得母马的样子了。
lines.en: I no longer recall what a mare looked like.

lines.zh: 两匹马相遇，先咬对方的颈。
lines.en: Two horses meet and bite each other's neck.

lines.zh: 别在我耳边说这些。
lines.en: Do not say such things near my ear.

lines.zh: 我的马厩空了，也不需要新的。
lines.en: My stable is empty. It needs no new occupants.

lines.zh: 我低头叼起掉落的缰。
lines.en: I dip my head and take up the fallen rein.

lines.zh: 蹄踩住的东西，我捡不起来。
lines.en: Things under my hooves I cannot pick up.

lines.zh: 我把那根布条甩到背上。
lines.en: I toss that strip of cloth onto my back.

lines.zh: 骑士掉了东西，我用鼻子推。
lines.en: The knight dropped something. I nudge it with my nose.

lines.zh: 我只认得马具，别的没用。
lines.en: I know harness only. The rest is useless.

lines.zh: 这枚蹄铁太小，不是我的。
lines.en: This horseshoe is too small. Not mine.

lines.zh: 我咬住它，又吐在地上。
lines.en: I take it in my teeth, then spit it out.

lines.zh: 我的嘴只适合咬，不适合拿。
lines.en: My mouth is for biting, not for carrying.

lines.zh: 你掉了东西，我替你踩住。
lines.en: You dropped something. I am standing on it.

lines.zh: 这块布我留着擦鞍。
lines.en: I will keep this cloth to wipe my saddle.

lines.zh: 那匹活马，我先冲它。
lines.en: That living horse. I charge it first.

lines.zh: 骑士用膝盖指了方向。
lines.en: The knight points with a knee.

lines.zh: 我嗅到草料和汗，跟着走。
lines.en: I catch fodder and sweat. I follow.

lines.zh: 活物都怕蹄声，先让他们听。
lines.en: The living fear hoofbeats. Let them hear first.

lines.zh: 我压低脖子，准备撞过去。
lines.en: I lower my neck, ready to ram through.

lines.zh: 拿长杆的那个，我认得姿势。
lines.en: The one with the long pole — I know that stance.

lines.zh: 栅栏很矮，我跨得过去。
lines.en: The fence is low. I can clear it.

lines.zh: 前面有人在跑，跑得不够快。
lines.en: Someone runs ahead. Not fast enough.

lines.zh: 两匹马对上了，先咬颈。
lines.en: Two horses face off. Go for the neck.

lines.zh: 我闻到马的恐惧，那最明显。
lines.en: I smell the horses' fear. It is the loudest.

lines.zh: 骑士不作声，我就当是同意。
lines.en: The rider says nothing, so I take it as consent.

lines.zh: 我朝火光的方向去。
lines.en: I head toward the firelight.

lines.zh: 他们挤成一团，正好冲散。
lines.en: They clump together. Perfect to break apart.

lines.zh: 我的蹄在土里刨了三下。
lines.en: My hoof scrapes the dirt three times.

lines.zh: 那股活物的气味，我很久没闻了。
lines.en: The smell of something living. I haven't had it in years.

lines.zh: 骑士的脚跟一碰，我就知道选谁。
lines.en: One nudge of the knight's heel, and I know who to pick.

lines.zh: 我侧过头，用一只眼看它。
lines.en: I turn my head and watch it with one eye.

lines.zh: 它举矛，我退半步再冲。
lines.en: It raises a spear. I give half a step, then charge.

lines.zh: 我绕圈，让骑士能看清。
lines.en: I circle so the knight can see clearly.

lines.zh: 它躲到树后，树挡不住我。
lines.en: It hides behind a tree. Trees do not stop me.

lines.zh: 我的鼻息没声音，它听不到。
lines.en: My breath makes no sound. It cannot hear me.

lines.zh: 骑士的枪尖在我头侧。
lines.en: The lance tip rests beside my head.

lines.zh: 我一步步逼近，不急着咬。
lines.en: I close in step by step, in no rush to bite.

lines.zh: 它在往后退，退到墙边就好。
lines.en: It retreats. Good, let it reach the wall.

lines.zh: 我听见它的马在发抖。
lines.en: I hear its horse trembling.

lines.zh: 等我冲起来，它没机会转身。
lines.en: Once I charge, it will not get to turn.

lines.zh: 我盯住它持武器的那只手。
lines.en: I fix on the hand that holds the weapon.

lines.zh: 我不叫，叫是活马的事。
lines.en: I do not whinny. Whinnying is for living horses.

lines.zh: 我压低头，准备把它顶翻。
lines.en: I duck my head, ready to flip it over.

lines.zh: 骑士的脚跟在我腹侧一碰。
lines.en: The knight's heel taps my flank.

lines.zh: 我放慢蹄子，把地面踩实。
lines.en: I slow my hooves and pack the ground firm.

lines.zh: 你退到坡上，我正好冲下来。
lines.en: You back up the slope, which is where I want you.

lines.zh: 我偏过头，让骑士的枪露出来。
lines.en: I angle my head so the knight's lance shows.

lines.zh: 你举盾挡在我面前，我不减速。
lines.en: You raise a shield in front of me. I don't slow.

lines.zh: 我一抬前蹄，把它踏倒。
lines.en: I rear and bring my forehooves down.

lines.zh: 我咬住它的肩膀，往后拖。
lines.en: I bite its shoulder and drag it backwards.

lines.zh: 后腿一蹬，正中它的胸口。
lines.en: Both hind legs lash out, square on its chest.

lines.zh: 我转身用臀撞它。
lines.en: I spin and hit it with my hindquarters.

lines.zh: 它倒在地上，我踩住武器。
lines.en: It falls, and I stand on its weapon.

lines.zh: 我的牙不锋利，咬住就不松。
lines.en: My teeth are not sharp, but once I bite, I hold.

lines.zh: 它抓我的鬃毛，那鬃是干的。
lines.en: It grabs my mane. The mane is dry dust.

lines.zh: 我一撞，它的盾就歪了。
lines.en: One shove and its shield goes crooked.

lines.zh: 蹄子落在膝弯上，它跪了。
lines.en: A hoof lands behind its knee. It kneels.

lines.zh: 我原地立起，把骑士送上去。
lines.en: I rear in place and lift the knight up.

lines.zh: 它砍到我前腿，我照样踢。
lines.en: It cuts my foreleg. I kick anyway.

lines.zh: 我把它顶到墙上，动不了。
lines.en: I pin it against the wall. It cannot move.

lines.zh: 我咬住它的披风，往回拽。
lines.en: I grip its cloak and haul backwards.

lines.zh: 骑士的剑从我耳旁过去。
lines.en: The knight's sword passes by my ear.

lines.zh: 我一口咬住你的盾沿，往上掀。
lines.en: I bite the rim of your shield and wrench it up.

lines.zh: 我的蹄子碾过你倒下的地方。
lines.en: My hooves grind over the spot where you fell.

lines.zh: 我在悚陵的石阶旁站起来。
lines.en: I rise beside the stone steps of the dread tomb.

lines.zh: 尸巫召我时，鞍已经备好。
lines.en: When the lich called me, the saddle was ready.

lines.zh: 我的蹄子先着地，然后才是腿。
lines.en: My hooves land first, then the legs.

lines.zh: 我记得这个马厩，也记得那场火。
lines.en: I remember this stable, and that fire.

lines.zh: 骑士还没来，我先站着等。
lines.en: The knight has not come. I stand and wait.

lines.zh: 土里翻出一具骨架，是我。
lines.en: A skeleton turns up in the soil. It is mine.

lines.zh: 我抖掉背上的土，鞍还是旧的。
lines.en: I shake off the soil; the saddle is still old.

lines.zh: 它们给我单独留了刷怪蛋。
lines.en: They left a spawn egg especially for me.

lines.zh: 我张嘴，喉咙里全是土。
lines.en: I open my mouth. My throat is full of soil.

lines.zh: 月亮出来时，我就站好了。
lines.en: When the moon came out, I was already standing.

lines.zh: 我闻到了骑士的味道。
lines.en: I catch the rider's scent.

lines.zh: 四条腿刚接上，还不太稳。
lines.en: My four legs are newly joined and not yet steady.

lines.zh: 悚陵的黑草，是我熟悉的草。
lines.en: The dark grass of the dread tomb is familiar.

lines.zh: 我嘶了一声，声音从肋骨出来。
lines.en: I whinny, and the sound comes out of my ribs.

lines.zh: 悚陵的土很松，我拱了三次才出来。
lines.en: The dread crypt soil is loose; it took three tries to get out.

lines.zh: 骑士先站起来，我才跟着站。
lines.en: The knight rises first, and only then do I.

lines.zh: 这一带没有活马，只有我。
lines.en: No living horse around here. Only me.

lines.zh: 我的第一声不是嘶，是骨头响。
lines.en: My first sound wasn't a whinny. It was bones shifting.

lines.zh: 毛烧起来，味道像我活着时。
lines.en: My coat burns. It smells like when I was alive.

lines.zh: 我从坡上滚下，盔甲声一路跟着。
lines.en: I roll down the slope, armor clattering all the way.

lines.zh: 水里我蹬不动，蹄陷进泥。
lines.en: In water my legs fail; hooves sink into mud.

lines.zh: 爆炸把鞍掀掉，骑士不见了。
lines.en: The blast tears off the saddle. The knight is gone.

lines.zh: 箭插在肩胛，像一根马刺。
lines.en: An arrow sticks in my shoulder like a spur.

lines.zh: 法术让我的腿僵了半刻。
lines.en: The spell freezes my legs for a moment.

lines.zh: 饿对我没意义，我只是空。
lines.en: Hunger means nothing to me. I am simply empty.

lines.zh: 雷落在我背上，我踩着它跑。
lines.en: Lightning strikes my back; I run through it.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有地，蹄子踏空。
lines.en: No ground in the void. My hooves strike nothing.
